messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: continuous-batching service (us-west-2, cb-pool-7) latency spike and queue pileup detected. Error rate up for model rdx-large-quant, auto-escalated to oncall.
Samir (oncall): On it. I can see a big tail in p95->p99 and queues creeping to ~18k. Starting triage — assigning roles. @elaine pls grab metrics/trace, @raj look at config/state, @maria check customer impact.
elaine: Grafana looks ugly — sudden jump at 10:12 UTC. Continuous_batch queue depth up from ~400 to 18k in ~3m, avg microbatch size also ballooned. Suspect kv cache thrash + prefetch causing jitter. Posting quick logs: ```
cb.queue_depth=18312
cb.microbatch_target=48
kv_cache.evictions/s=4200
kv_cache.load_lat_ms=15.2
```
raj: Confirmed: kv_cache.items grew then mass-evicted -> heavy IO on pooled hosts. I see many prefix cache insert spikes right before cliff. There was a config rollout 09:55 that changed prefetch_window from 16 -> 64 on cb-pool-7.
Samir (oncall): OK rollback prefetch_window to 16 for cb-pool-7 and reduce microbatch target to limit queueing. Rolling hotfix now.
raj: Pushing hotfix: ```
# hotfix for cb-pool-7
kubectl -n inference patch config cb-pool-7 --type=merge -p '{"continuous_batching": {"prefetch_window": 16, "max_microbatch_size": 16, "batching_window_ms": 5}}'
```
infra-bot: Patch applied to cb-pool-7 (revision v2026.3.14-hotfix). Pods rolling, 6/6 restarted.
elaine: After patch: queue depth down to ~2.2k, p95 improving but p99 still elevated. Eviction rate dropped ~10x. Latency graph: p50 ~ stable, p95 trending down from 1.4s -> 580ms.
maria: Customer impact — two customers (acme-ops, finixai) saw request timeouts and increased 429s between 10:11-10:30 UTC. No data exfiltration. Support tickets created, CS looped in. Estimated affected requests ~12k, error rate peaked at 1.8% cluster-wide.
Samir (oncall): Good. Also enabling temporary routing fallback for rdx-large-quant -> rdx-medium-quant (costlier for some workloads but lower memory pressure). Executing route change: ```
redwood-router update-route --pool cb-pool-7 --model rdx-large-quant --fallback rdx-medium-quant --fallback-weight 0.5
```
raj: Route change in place, traffic shaping applied. Keep monitoring for correctness.
elaine: Traces show some in-flight requests experienced repeated microbatch retries (3-4x) due to KV misses causing longer assembly times. That matches cache blowup hypothesis.
Samir (oncall): I'm going to disable prefix caching for the affected model on cb-pool-7 temporarily. That should reduce write amplification to the KV store. ```
kubectl -n inference patch config cb-pool-7 --type=merge -p '{"models": {"rdx-large-quant": {"kv_cache": {"enabled": false}}}}'
```
infra-bot: Model-level kv_cache disabled for rdx-large-quant on cb-pool-7.
elaine: After disabling prefix cache, eviction/insert spikes leveled off. Queue depth continues to fall to ~400. p99 still at ~1.2s but trending down.
maria: CS update drafted: "We observed a transient inference latency spike due to an internal caching interaction; mitigations are in place and traffic has been rerouted to lower-pressure variants. We’ll follow up with root cause and mitigations." Will send once we stabilize.
Samir (oncall): Agree. Next steps: keep patch for at least 1h, watch for regressions, run targeted replay of traffic to confirm stability. Also schedule rollback of prefetch change in config repo and add a canary for future prefetch increases.
raj: I'll open a rollback PR to revert prefetch_window change and add a feature-flagged rollout with 10% ramp. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/cb-configs/pull/312
elaine: Monitoring alert thresholds adjusted temporarily to avoid flapping: p95 alert bumped to 1.2s while we monitor recovery. Will set back after 1h of stability.
oncall-rotation: Samir, take a 30m cooldown and handoff at 11:30 UTC? I can pair for the follow-up postmortem.
Samir (oncall): Yup taking a break; leaving oncall notes: mitigation actions taken (prefetch rollback, microbatch cap, disable kv prefix cache, routing fallback). Still leaving watch for p99.
maria: Customer impact summary for postmortem: affected customers: acme-ops, finixai; peak affected requests ~12k; service degradation window 10:11-10:34 UTC; no data loss; follow-ups: compensation comms, configuration canary, KV store backpressure limits.
raj: Added instrumented logs for future triage: include kv_cache.size and kv_cache.insert_burst flag to alerts. Also adding a guard in runtime to refuse prefetch_window > 32 unless canary passed.
elaine: p99 is down to 620ms at 10:58 UTC. Queue depth stable < 300. Marking this as mitigated for now.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Root cause investigation and postmortem assigned to @raj and @elaine. Severity: Sev3.
oncall-rotation: I'll pick this up in next triage, will notify platform leadership in the postmortem thread. Leaving handoff: "Mitigated, watch p99 for 1h, follow postmortem steps in incident runbook." :white_check_mark:
Samir (oncall): Handoff ack. If anything flares, page me. Good job team. :thumbsup:
